title: Housing Costs Reveal Wealth Gaps

scenes.text: Most Americans spend 30% of income on rent, but the wealthy spend far less

scenes.label: OWN YOUR HOME EARLY
scenes.text: Buying a home before 35 cuts lifetime housing costs by up to 40% according to the Federal Reserve

scenes.label: RENTING IN HOT MARKETS
scenes.text: In markets where rent exceeds 35% of income, renters lose an extra $10,000‑$15,000 over ten years versus owners
